Hungary Expels 10 Russian Diplomats for 'Unacceptable Activities'

Hungary has expelled 10 Russian diplomatic staff, citing 'unacceptable activities'. The decision was announced by the Hungarian foreign minister. This action represents a significant departure from the previous era under Viktor Orban. The expulsions were reported by multiple international news outlets.
